## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] Read stage README and internalize the **Mental Model**
- [ ] Studied and executed example code
- [ ] Completed Exercise 1 (Easy) and passing unit tests
- [ ] Completed Exercise 2 (Medium) and passing unit tests
- [ ] Completed Exercise 3 (Hard) and passing unit tests
- [ ] Completed practical stage Challenge
- [ ] Answered Self-Review questions without peeking at solutions
- [ ] Performed code review (`review`) with **Go Reviewer**
- [ ] Verified tests clean with race detector: `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] Verified static analysis: `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Updated `learning/progress.yaml`
